CustomField.description: Optional. Performance threshold in milliseconds for this post-trigger action. When set, a run that takes that long or longer is logged, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. Leave blank to use the threshold of the linked trigger setting, or Log Setting when the row has no trigger setting or the setting has no threshold. 0 logs every run. A very high number stops the entries for this action. Post-trigger actions can do any work (summary queries, audit records, usage totals), so a threshold on each row lets admins choose which actions to watch.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Log a run of this post-trigger action that takes this many milliseconds or longer, even when Enable Trigger Performance Logging is off in Log Setting. Blank uses the trigger setting's threshold, or Log Setting when that is blank too.
CustomField.label: Performance Threshold (ms)
